create.name: Melissa Kim Corter
create.bio:
Melissa Kim Corter is a depth psychologist and writer whose work centres on the shadow side of the psyche. She holds a master's degree and a doctorate in depth psychology, with an emphasis on Jungian and archetypal studies, from Pacifica Graduate Institute, where her doctoral thesis examined psychopathy and the Western shadow. She also trained as a hypnotherapist at the Southwest Institute of Healing Arts, is an ordained minister and a certified medicolegal death investigator, and sits on the board of the International Association for Jungian Studies.

Her teaching uses fairy tales, myth, film, dreams and journaling to help people meet the hidden and disowned parts of themselves rather than turn away from them. She runs self-paced programmes on Jungian shadow work, soulful writing and the dark feminine, offers private consultations for writers and creatives, and writes a Substack called The Shadow Psychologist. Her books include Apothecary for the Afflicted, a collection of shadow work practices, Esoterica: The Shadow Worker's Codex, and the Wild Woman's book series. On The Shift Network she teaches courses on the myths of the dark goddess and on the alchemy of fairy tales.

books.title: Apothecary for the Afflicted: Shadow Work for Invisible Wounds
books.author: Melissa Kim Corter
books.description: A collection of shadow work practices set among dark, fairy-tale imagery. Corter offers reflective exercises for meeting the hidden and painful parts of the self with curiosity rather than fear.

books.title: Esoterica: The Shadow Worker's Codex
books.author: Melissa Kim Corter
books.description: A guide for people working with the shadow, drawing on Corter's Jungian training and her interest in symbolism and the macabre. It gathers concepts and practices for exploring the darker layers of the psyche.

books.title: The Wild Woman's Book of Shadows: A Magical Guide of Rituals + Practices for Living an Enchanted Life
books.author: Melissa Kim Corter
books.description: The first book in the Wild Woman's series, gathering rituals, practices and stories from Corter and a circle of women contributors. It offers seasonal and everyday practices for a more intentional, enchanted life.

courses.title: The Journey of the Dark Goddess
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network course in seven recorded modules, each built around the myth of a dark goddess such as Persephone, Hecate, Lilith, Baba Yaga, Medusa, Kali and Nyx. Each module pairs the myth with shadow work practices for self-trust and discernment.

courses.title: Jungian Shadow Work & the Alchemy of Fairy Tales
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network course of seven recorded modules, each exploring a fairy tale such as Cinderella, Hansel and Gretel or Vasilisa the Beautiful through a Jungian lens. Practices at the end of each module help students work with what the tale brings up.

courses.title: Retrieving the Pieces: A Deep Dive into Jungian Shadow Work
courses.description: A self-paced programme on how the shadow works in the psyche and how to integrate the parts of ourselves we have pushed aside. It combines teaching on Jungian ideas with guided practices.

courses.title: Bewitched: Breaking the Spell of Disempowerment
courses.description: A short, concentrated self-paced process for noticing and unwinding the unconscious patterns that keep us stuck. It blends psychology and spiritual practice.

courses.title: The Magic of Mischief
courses.description: Seven days of short guided practices rooted in spiritual psychology, aimed at creative expansion and play. One practice arrives each day.

courses.title: Write with Soul
courses.description: A self-paced writing programme that treats writing as a form of inner alchemy. It offers prompts and practices for finding and trusting your own creative voice.

courses.title: Beyond the Veil: Writing with the Ancestors
courses.description: A self-paced programme in stream-of-consciousness and automatic writing as a way of connecting with the authentic self and with ancestral memory. It includes guided practices to quiet the mind before writing.

courses.title: Weaving with Light
courses.description: A self-paced programme that weaves together psychology, hypnosis, shadow work and shamanic practice. It focuses on drawing on inner resources to shape the life you want.

courses.title: The Prosperity Process
courses.description: A self-paced programme that explores the inner patterns and beliefs shaping our relationship with money and prosperity. It uses shadow work and reflective practices.

courses.title: A Soulful Stillness
courses.description: A yoga nidra meditation offering for deep rest and a quiet mind. It is a short, low-cost way to try Corter's guided practice.

flags: She is listed as 'Dr. Melissa Kim Corter' on her site (doctorate in depth psychology, 2026); the name is kept without the title, as Spiritpedia drops honorifics not part of how someone is known. Add 'Dr.' if preferred.

Book title Apothecary for the Afflicted: 'Shadow Work for Invisible Wounds' is borderline wording (no condition named); kept. The Amazon listing also names Stephanie Wicker-Campbell and Cyndi Brannen (roles not shown, probably illustrator and foreword).
Esoterica: The Shadow Worker's Codex is a pre-order (UK listing gives 5 November 2026); the Amazon /dp/ page loads but the format and date could not be read.
The Wild Woman's books are anthologies she leads with many women contributors; listed under her name as on Amazon.
Her own programme prices come from her site's programmes page; the individual programme pages are Wix and descriptions were only partly readable, so descriptions are kept general.
left_out: Echo's Stolen Voice ($997, a programme on narcissism): left out as borderline (personality disorder theme).
The Glass Child workshop: description couldn't be read in full; left out as possibly about families with illness.
Prosperity Power Retrieval and Retrieving the Gold, The Storied Self (programmes page): left out to keep to 10 offerings.
Private consultations ($750 to $2,500): one-to-one, not her main way of working.
Video 'Tapping to release fear or anxiety with change': names anxiety.
Video 'Tapping Tuesday Darkness to Light' (uBxts0cyqEc): fails oEmbed (401).
Videos with guests (Lisa Williams; Asher Wright and Gregory Meadows) and short tapping clips: lower value or conversations rather than teaching.
The Wild Woman's Book of Prosperity and The Wild Woman's Book of Alchemy: 979 ISBNs, no amazon.com /dp/ page could be confirmed (B0BK1Z246G returned an error).
No free resources: the dark fairy tale quiz is a sign-up form, and her Substack is a newsletter.
